What happens in 30 days with the workbook:

Week 1: gather clues from American records and family stories
Week 2: work out which Poland: Russian, Prussian or Austrian
Week 3: search the indexes and archives online
Week 4: write to the parish, the registry office or the archive, with ready-made emails in Polish and English beside them

No Polish needed. And when a record is missing, the guide shows you where to look next.
